summary: A note effect: notes in, changed notes out, as a note insert before an instrument or a stage on a note wire (it makes no sound itself). Seven sections, each with its own On switch and applied in this order: Transpose (plus or minus 48 semitones); Scale (a key and one of ten scales, with the notes outside it moved to the nearest, the next one up or down, or dropped); Spread (each note moved by whole octaves in a cycle, up and down, or at random); Velocity (a soft-to-hard curve, an output range, a fixed value and a random change); Length (as played, a fixed length at the song's tempo or in milliseconds, or a minimum and maximum); Echo (up to 16 repeats at the song's tempo or in milliseconds, each quieter, shifted in pitch and shorter); Humanize (a random delay, a random velocity change, seeded). Every note it sends ends: when its source ends, by its length, or when the song stops. Use it to keep a part in key, fatten a line across octaves, shape how hard and how long every note plays, add rhythmic echoes to a lead, and loosen a machine-made part.
use_for: Change every note before a synth: transpose, snap to a key and scale, spread across octaves, shape velocity and length, add tempo-synced echoes and humanize. Sits before an instrument.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.description: Moves every note by the semitones below when on
parameters.how: Switches the Transpose section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off passes the pitch of every note on unchanged.

parameters.name: Semitones
parameters.description: How far every note moves: -48 to +48 semitones (a note that leaves the keyboard's 0 to 127 is dropped)
parameters.how: Moves every note up or down by this many semitones.
parameters.sound: Plus lifts the part, minus lowers it; 12 is an octave.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Moves every note into the key and scale below when on
parameters.how: Switches the Scale section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off leaves the notes as they are, in or out of key.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The scale's first note
parameters.how: Sets the first note of the scale.
parameters.sound: It moves the whole scale up or down together.

parameters.name: Scale type
parameters.description: The scale: Chromatic (every note is in it) or one of nine scales
parameters.how: Chooses the scale the notes are moved into.
parameters.sound: Major is bright and natural minor dark; the modes sit between them; Chromatic changes nothing, and with Filter keeps every note.

parameters.name: Out of scale
parameters.description: What happens to a note outside the scale: the nearest scale note (a tie goes down), the next one up, the next one down, or the note is dropped
parameters.how: Chooses how a note that is not in the scale is treated: moved to the nearest scale note, up to the next, down to the next, or left out.
parameters.sound: Nearest and Down keep a melody's shape, Up lifts the wrong notes, Filter plays only the notes that were already in key.

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: Moves each note by whole octaves in a pattern when on
parameters.how: Switches the Spread section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off keeps every note in the octave it was played in.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The most octaves a note is moved by (0 to 3)
parameters.how: Sets how many octaves the pattern may move a note, from 0 to 3.
parameters.sound: A wider range scatters a line across the keyboard; 0 changes nothing.

parameters.name: Pattern
parameters.description: How the octave shift changes from note to note: climbing and starting again, falling and starting again, up then down, or a seeded random choice from minus to plus the range
parameters.how: Chooses the order the octave shifts follow, note after note.
parameters.sound: Up cycle climbs in steps and drops back, Down cycle falls, Up-down rises and returns, Random scatters notes up and down (the same every time for the same Seed).

parameters.name: Velocity
parameters.description: Shapes the velocity of every note when on
parameters.how: Switches the Velocity section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off keeps the velocity of every note as played.

parameters.name: Curve
parameters.description: The velocity curve from soft (-100 %) to hard (+100 %); 0 leaves the velocities as played
parameters.how: Bends the velocity curve: minus pulls the middle velocities down, plus lifts them.
parameters.sound: Soft makes only the hardest hits loud; hard makes most notes loud and punchy.

parameters.name: Out min
parameters.description: The velocity a played velocity of 1 comes out as (1 to 127)
parameters.how: Sets the lowest velocity that comes out of the curve.
parameters.sound: Raising it keeps the quietest notes from vanishing.

parameters.name: Out max
parameters.description: The velocity a played velocity of 127 comes out as (1 to 127; it is never lower than Out min)
parameters.how: Sets the highest velocity that comes out of the curve.
parameters.sound: Lowering it keeps the hardest notes from being too loud.

parameters.name: Random
parameters.description: Each note's velocity changes by a random amount up to this share, from the seed
parameters.how: Changes each velocity by a random share, up to 50 %.
parameters.sound: A little makes a part uneven the way a hand is; a lot makes it unpredictable.

parameters.name: Fixed
parameters.description: Plays every note at the fixed velocity when on (the curve and range are skipped)
parameters.how: Switches the fixed velocity on, so every note comes out at the value below.
parameters.sound: Every note is equally loud, like a drum machine.

parameters.name: Fixed velocity
parameters.description: The velocity of every note when Fixed is on (1 to 127)
parameters.how: Sets the velocity used when Fixed is on.
parameters.sound: Higher plays every note harder and brighter on most instruments.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Shapes how long every note lasts when on
parameters.how: Switches the Length section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off ends every note when the key is released.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: As played: the note lasts as long as it was held. Fixed: every note lasts the same time. Clamp: a short note is held to the minimum and a long one ends at the maximum
parameters.how: Chooses between the played length, one fixed length and a minimum and maximum.
parameters.sound: Fixed makes a part staccato or legato whatever was played; Clamp tidies a part without making it mechanical.

parameters.name: Fixed timing
parameters.description: Whether the fixed length follows the song's tempo or is a time in milliseconds
parameters.how: Chooses between a fixed length at the song's tempo and one in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Song tempo keeps the length musical when the tempo changes; Free time keeps it the same time.

parameters.name: Fixed rate
parameters.description: The fixed length at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Sets the fixed length at the song's tempo, from a whole note to a sixty-fourth.
parameters.sound: Short values are staccato, long ones legato.

parameters.name: Fixed feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5 times as long) or triplet (two thirds as long)
parameters.how: Makes the fixed length straight, dotted or triplet.
parameters.sound: Dotted lengths run on, triplets are shorter and lilt.

parameters.name: Fixed time
parameters.description: The fixed length in milliseconds when the timing is Free time (5 to 4000)
parameters.how: Sets the fixed length in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Short times are clipped and dry, long times ring.

parameters.name: Clamp min
parameters.description: Clamp: a note shorter than this is held to this length (0 to 4000 ms)
parameters.how: Sets the shortest a note can be; the note-off waits until this time has passed.
parameters.sound: Raising it gives quick taps some body.

parameters.name: Clamp max
parameters.description: Clamp: a note longer than this ends at this length (5 to 4000 ms; never shorter than Clamp min)
parameters.how: Sets the longest a note can be; a held note ends when this time is up.
parameters.sound: Lowering it keeps long held notes from smearing.

parameters.name: Echo
parameters.description: Repeats every note when on
parameters.how: Switches the Echo section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off plays every note once.

parameters.name: Repeats
parameters.description: How many times each note is repeated (0 to 16)
parameters.how: Sets how many repeats follow each note.
parameters.sound: More repeats make a longer trail.

parameters.name: Echo timing
parameters.description: Whether the time between repeats follows the song's tempo or is in milliseconds
parameters.how: Chooses between repeats at the song's tempo and repeats a fixed time apart.
parameters.sound: Song tempo keeps the echo in time with the music; Free time ignores the tempo.

parameters.name: Echo rate
parameters.description: The time between repeats at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Sets the time between repeats at the song's tempo, from a whole note to a sixty-fourth.
parameters.sound: Short values make a fast flutter, long ones a slow answer.

parameters.name: Echo feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5 times as long) or triplet (two thirds as long) spacing
parameters.how: Makes the repeats straight, dotted or triplet.
parameters.sound: A dotted eighth echo is the classic lilting delay.

parameters.name: Echo time
parameters.description: The time between repeats in milliseconds when the timing is Free time (10 to 2000)
parameters.how: Sets the time between repeats in milliseconds.
parameters.sound: Short times thicken the note, long ones answer it.

parameters.name: Velocity drop
parameters.description: How much quieter each repeat is than the one before, as a share of its velocity (0 to 100 %; the echo stops when the velocity would fall below 1)
parameters.how: Sets how much of its velocity each repeat loses (the feedback of the echo, read as a loss).
parameters.sound: A small drop gives a long trail; a large drop makes the repeats die quickly.

parameters.name: Pitch step
parameters.description: Each repeat moves this many semitones from the one before (-12 to +12; a repeat that leaves 0 to 127 is dropped)
parameters.how: Moves each repeat up or down from the previous one by this many semitones.
parameters.sound: 7 makes rising fifths, -12 falling octaves, 0 a plain echo.

parameters.name: Echo length
parameters.description: The length of each repeat as a share of the note's length (10 to 100 %; never longer than the time between repeats)
parameters.how: Sets how long each repeat lasts compared with the note it repeats.
parameters.sound: Short repeats are plucked and clear; long ones blur into each other.

parameters.name: Humanize
parameters.description: Loosens the notes when on
parameters.how: Switches the Humanize section on or off.
parameters.sound: Off keeps every note exactly on time and at its velocity.

parameters.name: Humanize time
parameters.description: Each note is late by a random time up to this (0 to 50 ms); notes are only delayed, never early
parameters.how: Delays each note by a random time up to 50 ms, from the seed's random stream.
parameters.sound: A few milliseconds loosen a part; tens of milliseconds make it sloppy.

parameters.name: Humanize velocity
parameters.description: Each note's velocity changes by a random amount up to this share
parameters.how: Varies each note's velocity at random by up to 30 %.
parameters.sound: It makes repeated notes uneven in the way a hand is.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: The seed of the random stream (Random spread, Random velocity, Humanize): the same seed gives the same notes every time
parameters.how: Chooses which random sequence the Random controls follow.
parameters.sound: Different seeds give different loosenesses; the same seed always repeats exactly.

parameters.name: Keep chords
parameters.description: Notes that start on the same sample share one random delay, with only a few ms of spread between them, so a chord stays a chord (Off: every note has its own delay)
parameters.how: Notes that start together are delayed together: the chord gets one random delay up to Humanize time, and each note adds its own 0 to 8 ms (never more than Humanize time); lengths are kept.
parameters.sound: On keeps a chord tight while the whole hand is still loose; Off smears a chord's notes by up to Humanize time.
